explanation: Compared against the comments to Green's Problem 75: 'Pinchasi has shown that it is true with 100 replaced by O(log log n); this is the best-known upper bound.' The Lean statement: ∃ C : ℝ such that every finite X ⊂ ℝ² with #X ≥ 3 has distinct p, q ∈ X with imbalance ≤ C·log(log #X). The restriction to n ≥ 3 makes log log n > 0 (log log 3 ≈ 0.094), so the statement is neither vacuous nor false for small n given a large enough C. Faithful.
